subsystems.name: Compute array
subsystems.role: does the multiply-accumulate arithmetic at high parallelism.

subsystems.name: On-chip memory
subsystems.role: feeds weights and activations to the array fast enough to keep it busy.

subsystems.name: Data-movement fabric
subsystems.role: moves tensors between memory, array and the rest of the chip.

subsystems.name: Controller and scheduler
subsystems.role: sequences operations, tiles tensors and overlaps memory with compute.

subsystems.name: Numeric conversion
subsystems.role: translates between full-precision models and the low-precision formats the array uses.

subsystems.name: Host and power interface
subsystems.role: lets the CPU or GPU hand work to the NPU and gates unused blocks.

buildSteps.title: Define the workload and number formats
buildSteps.detail: Engineers choose INT8, FP16 or mixed precision, a throughput target in TOPS and a power budget set by the device's battery and cooling.

buildSteps.title: Design the architecture
buildSteps.detail: They decide the array size, dataflow, memory hierarchy and how much SRAM fits in the area budget.

buildSteps.title: Write and verify the RTL
buildSteps.detail: The design is described in hardware description language, then simulated, formally checked and run on emulators against real neural networks.

buildSteps.title: Do physical design
buildSteps.detail: Synthesis, floorplanning, place-and-route and timing closure turn the logic into a manufacturable layout, with careful clock and power distribution.

buildSteps.title: Integrate into the system-on-chip
buildSteps.detail: The NPU block is connected to CPU, GPU, memory and peripherals through the chip's interconnect, and its caches and power domains are tied in.

buildSteps.title: Fabricate the silicon
buildSteps.detail: A mask set is made and wafers are processed at an advanced logic node; each die is tested before packaging.

buildSteps.title: Package and validate
buildSteps.detail: The SoC is packaged, and system-level tests check thermal behaviour, power and real inference workloads.

buildSteps.title: Build the software stack
buildSteps.detail: A graph compiler, kernel library and runtime map models from frameworks onto the NPU, inserting quantisation and fallback paths.

buildSteps.title: Tune on device
buildSteps.detail: Operators that do not fit are optimised or offloaded, and power and thermal limits are tuned for sustained rather than peak performance.

prerequisites.why: dense, low-power transistors are needed to put a useful array on a phone chip.
weights and activations must sit close to the arithmetic to avoid burning energy on data movement.
models must tolerate INT8 or lower precision without losing useful accuracy.
without them, developers cannot easily get models onto the specialised hardware.
larger models still need to stream data from shared memory without stalling the array.

pathway.milestone: NPUs in smartphones, tablets and laptops handling camera, speech and photo tasks
pathway.unlocks: private, low-latency inference without a network round trip.

pathway.milestone: on-device large language models running with unified memory and mixed precision
pathway.unlocks: assistants that work offline and keep data on the device.

pathway.milestone: chiplets and heterogeneous compute that share memory between CPU, GPU and NPU
pathway.unlocks: larger models and more flexible scheduling on battery-powered devices.

pathway.milestone: in-memory and analog compute blocks for matrix multiplication
pathway.unlocks: much better energy efficiency, if accuracy and manufacturing variability can be controlled.
